messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 6(8)

Article 6 Categories of machinery and related products listed in Annex I subject to relevant conformity assessment procedures. 8. A Member State which has concerns about a category of machinery or related product being listed or not in Annex I shall immediately inform the Commission of those concerns and provide reasons in support thereof. The Commission shall conduct the assessment referred to in paragraph 4 immediately after being informed by a Member State. After making that assessment, the Commission may initiate the procedure laid down in paragraph 2.
